# Sales Forecasting Dashboard

## Overview

This project demonstrates how machine learning can be used to forecast future sales.

## Objectives

-   Forecast monthly sales
-   Identify seasonal patterns
-   Build interactive dashboards

## Methods

-   Data cleaning
-   Feature engineering
-   Model training

## Results

The model successfully captured seasonal trends and improved forecast accuracy.
